prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_split_layout_redesign: Redesign the choose path screen using a split layout to clearly compare pet adoption paths side-by-side.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split"}}
1: [home, new_screen] waiting_pet_care_tips_screen: Insert a new screen before waiting that introduces desktop pet interaction basics while the pet is generating.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_waiting_tips", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_waiting_tips": {"headline": "Pet Care & Desktop Basics", "body": "While your pet is getting ready, here is how you will interact with them on your desktop.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_split_account_restoration_redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout focusing on account restoration to prevent pet loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In & Restore Your Pet", "hint": "Use your original account credentials to ensure your existing pet data is safely loaded."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] adoption_certificate_signoff_flow: Add step counters, progress indicators, and an interactive adoption commitment checklist to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "I promise to care for and interact with my pet on my desktop daily."}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_time_estimate_and_notify: Display explicit completion time estimates and turn on background notifications when pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Companion...", "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
5: [adoption, layout] pick_friend_grid_layout: Switch the pick friend screen to a grid layout for better side-by-side comparison of pet options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid"}}
6: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_restoration_hint: Add a dedicated hint on the sign-in screen explaining account persistence and how to restore existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Returning user? Sign in with your original email/provider to restore your saved pets."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] story_intro_welcome_banner: Add a cheerful mascot welcome message and clear headline to the opening story screen.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets!", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Let's find or create the perfect desktop companion for your screen!"}]}}
8: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_interaction_copy: Update the home intro text with clear guidance on how to locate the pet on desktop and right-click to open pet controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look near your taskbar or main display screen. Right-click your pet at any time to manage settings, chat, or hide them."}}
9: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_guidance_hint: Provide clear photo selection tips and delayed guidance timing on the upload photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best custom pet results, upload a clear, centered, well-lit portrait photo.", "tip_delay_seconds": 4}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning choose path into a split layout retains its required function within onboarding.
Adding a new pet care tips screen inside onboarding without removing mandatory steps is allowed.
Redesigning sign in to emphasize account restoration retains the sign-in step without violating rules.
Replacing components on the adoption certificate with a checklist removes the required official stamp.
Displaying generation estimates and background notifications during the waiting screen is permitted.
Switching pick friend to a grid layout preserves its function while improving comparison.
Adding account restoration hints to the sign-in screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a mascot welcome banner to the story screen retains its pet introduction function.
Updating home intro guidance text is allowed within onboarding bounds.
Adding photo selection tips and delayed guidance to the upload photos screen is permitted.
